title: Live wild Rattata completes an exact-frame Walk

verification.actor: WILD species 19 (rattata), acquired through spawn; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Wait for the same live Rattata to start a natural four-frame Walk; Observe every rendered frame, its one terminal commit, engine clear, and idle control return
verification.observable: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result; No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation; Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels; No active actors share a nonzero target reservation; Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch; Every active actor has an attached presentation

setupMutations.change: Disposable test.sav, checked teleport and native Rattata spawn request. Bind only the request's finalized identity and own landing point; wait idle before measurement. Do not change profile timing, AI direction or counters.

limits: Prepared spawning does not prove natural population spawning or selection UI.
One complete four-frame natural Walk retains all seven original measurements and proves that a Wild actor reaches the shared middle acceleration tier; it is not long-soak proof.
Requires a current accepted separate same-reader clear control and controller replay of all required wrong-data controls. Registration alone is not runtime acceptance.
